output.headerText:
OR3 DB Sync Layer — Security / Integrity Audit Pack

Scope: Client sync engine (outbox, HLC, LWW, GC, snapshots), gateway sync provider, SSR sync API (push/pull/snapshot/cursor/GC), shared wire schemas/sanitize, rate limiting, related docs/tests.

Primary surfaces:
1. app/core/sync/* — outbox coalescing, conflict resolver, cursor/GC, hook-bridge capture
2. server/api/sync/* — push/pull/snapshot/cursor/GC endpoints (can()-gated)
3. server/utils/sync/rate-limiter — request-based 429 / Retry-After behavior
4. shared/sync/* — schemas, sanitize, revision, table metadata, history GC policy
5. server/sync/gateway — adapter registry boundary
6. app/plugins/convex-sync.client.ts — client sync bootstrap

Invariants auditors should verify: op_id idempotency, contiguous server_version, LWW clock+hlc, remote-apply suppression, tombstone GC vs min device cursor, workspace scoping.

Excluded: Auth engine (separate pack), blob storage transfers (separate pack), provider package dist/ (Convex/SQLite implementations live in or3-provider-*), plugins/themes/webhooks.
